title: Malnutrition in Older Adults
subtitle: Nutrition science and practical planning related to malnutrition in older adults.
evidence_strength: Established evidence for malnutrition definitions, prevalence, physiology, and clinical impact; moderate evidence for intervention efficacy and best practice strategies; emerging evidence on integration of multidisciplinary care; some uncertainty regarding optimal screening frequency and intervention modalities.
review_status: AI draft - scientific, clinical, and editorial review required
